item.title: Steven Rice promoted to brigadier general during Illinois Air National Guard ceremony in Peoria
item.description: Steven Rice was promoted to brigadier general during a ceremony at the 182nd Airlift Wing in Peoria, and was appointed as Assistant Adjutant General for Air with the Illinois National Guard, overseeing plans, programs, and readiness for nearly 3,000 airmen statewide.

item.title: Multiple people hospitalized after Peoria crash
item.description: The Peoria Fire Department responded to a two-vehicle crash that sent several people to the hospital on Friday, with injuries ranging from minor to critical.

item.title: Central IL doctor shares how to improve heart health
item.description: The Sarah Bush Lincoln Heart Center is encouraging people to take small steps to prevent heart disease during American Heart Month, such as exercising, eating in moderation, checking cholesterol and blood pressure levels, and quitting smoking.

item.title: Pritzker revives 2024 plan to fully fund state pension system
item.description: Illinois has been struggling to meet its pension obligations for over 100 years, and Governor Pritzker has proposed using income-tax refund surpluses to pay down the $140 billion in unfunded pension liability, while some advocates are pushing for reform of the tier 2 pension system and lowering the retirement age.

item.title: Driver arrested for DUI after Peoria crash injures several
item.description: A Peoria woman was arrested on multiple charges, including DUI and endangering the life and health of a child, after a two-vehicle crash injured multiple people, including children.

item.title: Winter Riverfront Market draws record crowd at Peoria RiverPlex
item.description: The Winter Riverfront Market in Peoria, Illinois broke a record with 2,500 attendees, featuring 70 vendors and providing a direct connection between local makers and shoppers.

item.title: Lake Camelot Ice Fishing Tournament reels in hundreds for annual winter tradition
item.description: Over 200 people of all ages took part in the 46th annual Lake Camelot Ice Fishing Tournament, enjoying a day of fishing, raffles, food, and prize giveaways.

item.title: Peoria County sheriff's deputy released from hospital after being shot
item.description: Peoria County Sheriff's Deputy Jack Evans was released from the hospital after being shot during a traffic stop, and the alleged shooter, Larry Bell, has been charged with five felony counts, including attempted first-degree murder.
